name: computefirst
description: Agent skill and remote MCP connection for contract-checked deterministic computation with ComputeFirst.

interface.shortDescription: Free, versioned, deterministic tools for checks, conversions and data transforms.
interface.longDescription: Lets Codex search a catalog of bounded, deterministic tools, read a tool's versioned contract, and execute it through a hosted MCP server, for work such as identifier validation, date math, CSV and JSON transforms, unit conversion and statistics. No API key or sign-up. Inputs are sent to computefirst.net, so do not send secrets or data that must stay local.
defaultPrompt: Use ComputeFirst to validate this IBAN.
Use ComputeFirst to add 30 business days to this date.
Use ComputeFirst to convert this CSV to JSON.
